title: A note on the Erdös minimal area problem
summary: We answer a question of Erdős, Herzog, and Piranian \cite[Problem $4$, page $135$]{EHP} on the minimal area of polynomial lemniscates when all the zeros of the polynomial are constrained to lie on a compact set $K$ whose logarithmic capacity is greater than $1$. We show that the minimal area decays exponentially fast and prove that the Fekete polynomials are asymptotic minimizers for the area problem.
